verdict.rationale: Alma publishes both halves of the story. The O-1A page lists its own processing time (~31 business days) next to government times (15 business days premium processing, 4-6 months standard USCIS). Elsewhere it states and guarantees a ~2-week case-preparation turnaround once evidence is collected. Missing for 10: equivalent provider-plus-government timeline breakdowns for visa types other than O-1A (the EB-1 guide only mentions 'wait time'), an explanation of how the ~31-day and ~2-week figures relate, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the published timelines hold.
